question_cn: 阻塞（Blockade）战术的核心机制是什么？
question_en: What is the core mechanism of the blockade tactic?

options.text_cn: 用己方棋子攻击对方棋子，迫使其移走后吃掉其保护的目标
options.text_en: Attack an opposing piece and capture its protected target after it moves away

options.text_cn: 将己方棋子占据对方兵（或棋子）前方的关键格，使其无法前进或形成威胁
options.text_en: Place one of your pieces on a key square in front of an enemy pawn or piece to stop its advance or prevent it from creating a threat

options.text_cn: 牺牲子力引诱对方棋子走到不利位置，再用叉将收割
options.text_en: Sacrifice material to lure an enemy piece onto an unfavorable square, then win it with a fork

options.text_cn: 插入棋子切断对方两子之间的横/纵/斜线联系
options.text_en: Interpose a piece to cut the rank, file, or diagonal connection between two enemy pieces

explanation_cn: 阻塞的本质是「封死」：用己方棋子站在对方兵的前进格，让对方兵无法推进或升变；也可用于封锁对方重子的关键通道。阻塞子本身往往不怕被吃——吃掉阻塞子有时正好开路，但代价更大。
explanation_en: A blockade shuts down an enemy piece by occupying a key square in its path, especially the square in front of a passed pawn, preventing it from advancing or promoting. It can also restrict a major piece's important route. The blockading piece may be offered as a sacrifice if capturing it creates an even greater cost.
